demos.name: BasicLegend
demos.description: In chart components, the legend links series with label properties and their colors.

demos.name: ToggleSeriesVisibility
demos.description: This demo shows how hiding series can impact the x-axis.

demos.name: StackLineVisibility
demos.section: Toggle visibility › Stack series edge case
demos.description: In this demo, hiding the blue series (New York) decreases the values of the two other ones as expected.

demos.name: VisibilityOnChange
demos.description: The demo below shows a line chart where you can toggle series' visibility and see the count of currently visible series.

demos.name: ControlledVisibility
demos.description: The demo below shows how to control which items are visible using buttons.

demos.name: LegendDimension
demos.description: The example below shows how to customize parts of the legend and how to use both the legendClasses variable and the CSS class directly.

demos.name: LegendPosition
demos.description: When composing custom charts, this behavior is handled by the legendPosition prop of the ChartsWrapper.

demos.name: HiddenLegend
demos.description: You can hide the legend with the hideLegend prop of the Chart.

demos.name: LegendTextStyling
demos.description: The mark is an SVG element, so you can use the fill property to change its color.

demos.name: LegendMarkType
demos.description: You can change the mark shape using the labelMarkType property of the series item.

demos.name: LegendCustomLabelMark
demos.description: For more advanced use cases, you can provide a component to the labelMarkType property of each series to fully customize the mark.

demos.name: ScrollableLegend
demos.description: You can make the legend scrollable by setting overflowY for vertical legends or overflowX for horizontal legends.

demos.name: LegendStyleSeries
demos.description: You can use CSS to style the series in the legend.

demos.name: CustomLegend
demos.description: This approach uses slots to render the legend items.

demos.name: VeryBasicColorLegend
demos.description: You can override the legend slot to display the desired legend, or use the composition API to add as many legends as needed.

demos.name: BasicColorLegend
demos.description: - axisDirection: 'x', 'y', or 'z' - indicates which axis contains the colorMap definition - axisId: The ID of the axis to use (if the selected direction contain

demos.description: - With direction='horizontal', 'inline-start' and 'inline-end' position labels inline with the marker - With direction='vertical', these work the same as 'start
